measured_sorting_proxy.measure: End-to-end food-to-compost proxy against repaired object labels
measured_sorting_proxy.matching: Confidence-ordered one-to-one bounding box IoU>=0.5; existing display threshold0.25 and automatic threshold0.50; no threshold tuning
limitations: Ground-truth compost eligibility derives from user food-to-compost policy and existing AI-reviewed food boxes, not independently labeled disposal categories.
Only automatic compost assignments are measurable here. No independent recycling/landfill material or empty-container labels exist.
Unmatched automatic assignments include duplicate detections, wrong object detections or box IoU below0.5; these are not all proven wrong-material disposal decisions.
Review is abstention and is never counted as correct sorting. Ground-truth misses remain in recall denominator.
Historical checkpoint exposure and uncertain test annotations remain; this is an exposed development-set proxy, not independent generalization.

recycling_candidate_recognition.measure: Bottle/carton recognition as candidates for recycling; final bin still conditional
recycling_candidate_recognition.matching: Confidence-ordered one-to-one IoU>=0.5, matching within each reported group; thresholds unchanged
limitations: Existing object labels identify bottles/cartons, not liquid contents, local carton acceptance or final disposal category.
Recognition is not final-bin sorting accuracy. Empty state is not inferred or assumed.
No review case counts as correct automatic recycling.
Historical image exposure and AI-assisted annotation uncertainty remain.
